piece.name: Second Melody Test
piece.title: Second Melody Test
piece.notes: Isolated test of the new SectionModel.second_melody field. Lead melody runs plain free rhythm (no groove) at the normal 4/4 bar grid. second_melody carries its own rhythm_pattern with length_beats=3.0, tiled continuously across the full 16-bar (64-beat) section via rhythm_pattern_to_events -- since 3 doesn't divide the 4-beat bar evenly, its onsets should drift out of phase with the bar grid over the section instead of resyncing every bar: genuine polymeter, not just a different subdivision. One counterpoint voice also present to prove second_melody coexists with the existing counterpoint list mechanism without conflict.

sections.name: main
sections.notes: Lead in plain 4-beat free rhythm, second_melody cycling every 3 beats -- classic 3-over-4 polymeter, should audibly drift through the bar over 16 bars.
